name: Hikari
source:
The friendly guide of “Echoes of Kyoto.” With her charming presence and extensive database, she leads users deep into the world of the Meiji era. By holding direct conversations and gathering real-time feedback, she continuously refines the system to enhance the experience. 

[From [url=https://duskindexgion.bushiroadgames.com/en/#character]Official English website[/url]]
